evidence.title: DialKit — Tune interfaces in real time
GitHub - joshpuckett/dialkit: A library to help you dial in interface parameters of any kind

name: DialKit
summary: npm library that mounts live controls in a running app to tune motion, layout, color and animation timing.
description: A library that adds a control panel to your running interface: sliders, toggles, text, select, color and image controls, spring and easing editors, versions, presets and an animation timeline. Adapters cover React 18+, Solid, Svelte, Vue and plain JavaScript.
contains: controls: slider, toggle, text, select, color, image, XY pad, spring, easing, action and folder
animation timeline with clips, scrub, resize and playback
presets, versions and persistence to localStorage
framework adapters: React 18+, Solid 1.6+, Svelte 5.8+, Vue 3.3+, vanilla JavaScript
agent prompts and a markdown agent guide
